subject: Implement boot-time unread sweep
description:
In `capo/main.py` startup: before serving the webhook, call `amc.get_unread()`, enqueue any unacked envelopes through the same dispatcher worker queue, then start the FastAPI server.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] On boot, `amc.get_unread()` is called BEFORE FastAPI starts serving.
- [ ] Returned envelopes are enqueued through the per-channel dispatcher (same path as webhook envelopes).
- [ ] On AMC unreachable: retry with backoff up to `max_boot_wait_seconds` (default 60s); after that, proceed and log a warning.
- [ ] Successful sweep is logged with envelope count.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Empty unread list: server starts immediately after one successful sweep.
- [ ] Capo offline >13 min: AMC has dead-lettered older messages; sweep recovers what's still buffered.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Sweep failure within `max_boot_wait_seconds` → warning, continue boot.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: restart with N unread → all N arrive at agent exactly once (verifies "exactly once" delivery via dedupe)
• Integration: AMC offline at boot → boot proceeds after `max_boot_wait_seconds` with warning

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.2, 6.4, 7.5, 9.1
